title: Neon Grand Prix
pitch:
The Kart Time Trial becomes NEON GRAND PRIX, a 3D evening-stage race round the island.

Who races:
- The child's active pet, wearing its accessories, drives their own kart in its locked colour.
- The rivals are the Glow Crew: Gumdrop, Fizz, Sprout, Plum and Noodle, five original bean mascots who race at the child's level.

Every bend and straight offers a choice:
- Hold ✨ DRIFT for cyan → pink → gold Spark Boosts.
- Hit the pulsing Beat Strips on the beat for a bigger boost.
- Collect a full trail of ♪ Glow Notes.
- Tap ✨ in the air off the Stage Jump for a trick.

Stylish driving fills a light-stick HYPE WAND. When it is full the child gets SPOTLIGHT: the stage beams lock onto their kart, the crowd's wands switch to their signature colour, and they get a short speed lift.

Each race builds like a concert:
- Lap 1 is golden-hour SOUNDCHECK.
- Lap 2 is SHOWTIME.
- The final lap is the neon ENCORE LAP, with a key change and sweeping spotlights.
- It ends with confetti cannons and the pet's own dance.

Fairness and scoring:
- The score is still the honest race clock, so GAME_RULES.kart and the PB keys are unchanged.
- Rivals work one way only: they never touch you, and they can never change your time or your Hype.
- Medals (Bronze → Silver → Gold → Holo) and Stage classes (Trainee → Debut → Headliner) are both read from that one PB time, so no new data is saved.
- Nothing is random, nothing costs or earns ⭐, and nobody is ever knocked out.
coreLoop:
The game runs on the existing fixed 120 Hz step. The loop works at five time scales.

EVERY SECOND
- Steer and keep the gas on (or let Easy Drive hold it).
- Read the next bend from the ribbon and the arch colours, and the next Beat Strip from its pulse.
- Choose a line:
  - the centre is safe
  - the outside line catches the offset Beat Strip
  - the inside line catches the ♪ trail

EVERY BEND (4–13 per lap, depending on the track)
- Hold ✨ while steering above 150 px/s. The kart hops for 0.12 s, then slides.
- Sparks climb Cyan (0.55 s) → Pink (1.1 s) → Gold (1.8 s). Let go to boost for 0.5 / 0.9 / 1.3 s.
- The ✨ pad glows the current spark colour, so a 6-year-old needs only one rule: 'let go on pink'.
- The risk is real. A longer drift means a wider line, which brings grass (the charge drains) or the wall (the charge fizzles, and Hype and Spotlight are lost) closer.

EVERY STRAIGHT
- Beat Strips: on-beat = 1.1 s boost, off-beat = 0.7 s.
- Glow Note trails.
- Once per lap, the Stage Jump: tap ✨ in the air for a trick and a landing boost.

EVERY LAP (about 16–36 s)
- Pass gates 1-2-3 and then the line. This progress logic is unchanged.
- Each clean gate gives +2 Hype.
- The Hype Wand fills about once every 1–1.5 laps and fires SPOTLIGHT for 6 s.
- The lighting steps Soundcheck → Showtime → ENCORE LAP. The final lap brings a key change, stage cones and fireworks.

EVERY RACE (about 50–120 s; laps 3 / 3 / 2 as today)
- The countdown has a musical count-in. Rocket-start window: GO pressed in the last 0.25 s before GO or the first 0.15 s after it.
- You start last on a 6-kart grid, so every race opens with passing.
- Finish: the time freezes at the line, then a 0.6 s slow-mo, confetti cannons and the pet's signature dance during a 2.2 s victory coast.
- Results show the place (Race) or the pacer gap (Solo), the medal for this time, ONE next-target line ('Next: 🥇 Gold 0:50.50 — 1.9 s to go') and the style stats.

EVERY SESSION
- ↻ Play again is one tap and an instant rematch, with no intro.
- The menu always names the next medal and the next Stage class to unlock.
- The parent's arcade limits apply exactly as today.
controls:
TOUCH (shell pads, existing size clamp(64px, 13vmin, 104px)):
- Left group: ⬅ ➡.
- Right group: ⬇ (aria 'Brake'), ✨ (aria 'Drift and trick'), GO (wide, aria 'Accelerate').
- EASY DRIVE ON: auto-gas, implemented as an input transform up = !down. GO is hidden and ✨ becomes the wide pad, labelled '✨ DRIFT'.
- Supplied through the new optional def.controlsFor(cfg).

KEYBOARD:
- Arrows / WASD as today.
- Space, Shift or X = ✨ (held id 'drift').
- C cycles the camera (3D only; a listener owned by the view).
- P / Esc pause (shell).

ONE BUTTON, THREE CONTEXTS. ✨ means:
- hold while steering = drift
- tap while airborne = trick
- in Easy Drive, tap in the rocket window = rocket start
(In normal mode the rocket start is a GO press in the window.)

PAD FEEDBACK (new optional round.padState(id) → data-st on the pad):
- ✨ glows Neon Cyan / Neon Pink / Star Gold by spark tier.
- Grey while the charge drains on grass.
- Steady gold 'ready' while the trick window is open.
- GO, or ✨ in Easy Drive, glows a steady gold during the rocket window.
- Nothing ever blinks faster than 2 Hz.

MENU OPTIONS (new optional def.menuOptions, rendered by the shell as .slg-var chip rows with aria-pressed). Stored per profile in localStorage key 'slKart:v1:<profileKey>', wrapped in try/catch:
- Mode: 🏁 Race | ⏱️ Solo.
- Stage, Race only: 🌱 Trainee | 🎤 Debut (🔒 until you have a Bronze time on this track) | 👑 Headliner (🔒 until you have a Silver time).
- Easy Drive: On | Off. Default On for a profile with no kart PB on any track, otherwise their last choice.
- Camera, 3D only: Chase | Stage | Map.

FAIRNESS: Easy Drive is input-only and every camera is view-only. Physics are identical for every option, class, mode and kart colour, so a PB means the same thing everywhere.

STEERING RULE KEPT: a stopped kart can still turn on the spot.
mechanics:
UNITS AND TIME:
- Logic stays in px on the existing 2304×1296 world, with the 120 Hz fixed step.
- 40 px = 1 u for the 3D view.
- All timers use sim time s.t, which starts at 0 at GO.
- The logic never uses Math.random or Date.
- Shared constants live in kart-logic.js PHYS.

BASE PHYSICS, UNCHANGED:
- ACCEL 430, BRAKE 620, DRAG 260, VMAX 270, VMAX_GRASS 135, VREV -110, TURN 2.9
- HW 50, KERB 8, VERGE 46, WALL 110
- grip = max(0.45, min(1, |v|/110))
- overspeed bleed 300 px/s² on tarmac, 700 px/s² on grass
- the wrong-way timer (alongV < -40 builds it, >0.6 s shows the banner)
- the windowed nearest() search (±8 samples)
- updateProgress with gates [0.25, 0.5, 0.75], the maxStep infield guard and lap counting

NEW CAPS:
- VBOOST 335 px/s, reached at BOOST_ACC 900 px/s² while boostT > 0. This applies even without throttle and lifts the grass cap; it only affects the verge, because walls still bound the track.
- Holding brake cancels a boost.
- Spotlight multiplies vmax by 1.05 (283.5).
- Hard clamp VCAP 350 px/s in every state.

TIME FLOOR at VCAP:
- Island Loop 4,736 px × 3 laps = 40.6 s
- Volcano Ring 5,304 px × 3 = 45.5 s
- Beach Hairpins 8,981 px × 2 = 51.3 s
All are well above GAME_RULES.kart.minMs 30 s.

STEP ORDER (race.step(dt, inp)), once per 120 Hz tick:
1. Save the previous pose (px, py, ph) for view interpolation.
2. Advance s.t.
3. Transform input: Easy Drive sets up = !down; detect rising edges.
4. Rocket check.
5. Find nearest() and onGrass.
6. Branch on state: SPIN, AIR or GROUND (drift state machine, boost, throttle/brake/drag, clamps, steering).
7. Count down boostT and spotlightT.
8. Move along the travel angle: h - dir × slide, or spinDir during a spin.
9. Graded wall contact.
10. updateProgress, emitting gate and lap events plus clean-gate logic.
11. Beat Strips, Glow Notes, Stage Jump.
12. Wrong-way timer.
13. Rivals and pacers (pure, one-way).
14. Places and passes.
15. Finish and coast.

After the finish, progress is frozen: the coast moves the pose only.

ROCKET START (race start only):
- The shell calls round.countdown(countT, held, isStart) on every countdown tick.
- A fresh press (rising edge) of GO, or of ✨ in Easy Drive, while 0 < countT ≤ 0.25 with isStart true arms it.
- So does a fresh press while 0 ≤ s.t ≤ 0.15 after GO.
- Holding the button from earlier does not count; it must be a fresh press in the window.
- Reward: a 1.0 s boost at VBOOST, +5 Hype and the 'ROCKET START!' event, once per race.
- The countdown on resume after a pause has isStart false, so a rocket never fires.
- No flood penalty.

DRIFT AND SPARKS:
- Entry requires all of: ✨ held, exactly one of left/right held, v ≥ 150, on tarmac (nearest d ≤ HW+KERB), not airborne, not spinning.
- dir = the side being steered. A 0.12 s hop follows, during which steering is normal and the slide angle ramps 0 → 0.28 rad.
- Turn rate while drifting = dir × (1.7, +1.1 when steering into the drift, −0.9 when steering against it) rad/s, so 0.8–2.8 rad/s.
- Travel angle = h − dir × 0.28. Speed is capped at 0.97 × the current vmax.
- Charge grows 1.0/s on tarmac and drains 2.0/s on grass (sparks grey, never below 0).
- Tiers: T1 ≥ 0.55 s (Cyan), T2 ≥ 1.1 s (Pink), T3 ≥ 1.8 s (Gold).
- Release (✨ up) boosts for 0.5 / 0.9 / 1.3 s and gives +3 / +5 / +8 Hype. Releasing before T1 gives nothing and costs nothing.
- Below v 120 the drift cancels with no boost.
- Any wall contact while drifting is a 'fizzle': charge lost, plus the wall consequence.
- round.pauseReset() cancels an active drift with no boost.
- After exit the slide angle relaxes to 0 over 0.12 s.
- Prototype check on the real tracks: a T1/T2 drifter gains about 2 s on Island Loop and 7–9 s on Volcano Ring and Beach Hairpins against the plain driver, with zero walls.

BEAT STRIPS (logic boost pads, auto-placed in buildTrack, deterministic):
- Candidates are 'straights': runs where the bend over the next 200 px is < 0.35 rad, of length ≥ 300 px. The pad goes at run start + 2 samples.
- Reject a candidate if any point in the next 320 px has a bend over 170 px of > 1.0 rad.
- Reject if within 200 px of the Stage Jump, within 60 px of a gate or the line, or within 0.15 × lap of an accepted pad.
- Cap at 4. The real tracks each get 3 today.
- Lateral offset alternates 0 and 0.45 × HW toward the OUTSIDE of the next bend (the risk: it pulls you wide).
- Size 70 px along × 40 px across.
- Trigger when the kart centre is inside the pad, alongV > 80, the kart is not airborne and that pad's 1.2 s cooldown is over. Wiggling or reversing never re-triggers.
- BEAT: half-time of 140 BPM, BEAT2 = 120/140 s ≈ 0.857 s. A pad is LIT when (s.t mod BEAT2) < BEAT2/2.
- Lit (on-beat): 1.1 s boost, +5 Hype, 'ON BEAT!'. Unlit: 0.7 s boost, +3 Hype.
- Judged on sim time only, so it works muted and with Bluetooth audio lag.

GLOW NOTES (♪, the youngest player's collectable):
- 3 trails per lap, nominally at 0.12 / 0.40 / 0.66 of the lap.
- Each trail slides forward in steps of 0.01 lap (at most 0.08) until it is clear of gates ±150 px, pads ±150 px and the jump ±250 px; if it can't clear, it is skipped.
- 5 notes per trail, 48 px apart along the track.
- Lateral offset 0.5 × HW toward the INSIDE of the bend within the next 400 px, or alternating ± per trail on straights. Every note centre stays within HW.
- Pickup radius 26 px from the kart centre.
- Each note can be collected once per lap; all respawn on the lap event.
- +1 Hype per note, +2 bonus for a full trail of 5.

STAGE JUMP (one per track):
- Placed full-width at 60% along the longest straight (Loop sample 46, Volcano 83, Beach 61 with today's tracks). Length 64 px.
- Launch when progress P crosses its line forwards, v ≥ 160, not airborne, and more than 500 px since the last launch.
- airDur = 0.35 + 0.0012·v s (0.54–0.75 s); peak height airH = 24 px × v/270 on a parabola.
- In the air: steering at 35%, no throttle, brake or drag; walls still apply, and ANY contact while airborne counts as a bump.
- Progress keeps using the windowed nearest() with maxStep, so a jump can never skip a gate.
- TRICK: a ✨ rising edge during the first 70% of airDur means the pet does a star-pose spin. Landing then gives a 0.6 s boost and +5 Hype.
- An untricked landing has no penalty.

GRADED WALLS:
- Contact happens when nearest d > WALL.
- v_n = v × max(0, cos(travel − outward normal)).
- All grades keep today's reposition to WALL−3 and today's 50% nose nudge along the track and 0.3 rad inward, so the existing never-pinned guarantee holds. (Prototype: min 219 px moved vs the 200 px test.)
- No extra knock-back.

GRADES:
- SCRAPE, v_n < 70: v × 0.88, −2 Hype.
- BUMP, 70 ≤ v_n < 180, or any contact while airborne: v × 0.5, the drift fizzles, the boost is cancelled, −8 Hype, Spotlight ends. About 0.16–0.4 s lost.
- SPIN-OUT, v_n ≥ 180: v × 0.35, spinT = 0.8 s. The kart slides along the nudged heading with v decaying at 600 px/s²; throttle and steering are ignored. Then the heading snaps to the forward track tangent (mercy). Hype goes to 0, Spotlight ends, the boost and drift are cancelled. About 1.1 s lost (measured).

COUNTERS:
- s.wall++ for ANY grade, debounced 0.4 s as today, so the existing tests keep their meaning.
- Plus s.scrapes, s.bumps and s.spins.
- With opts.features === false the legacy model applies (v × 0.45 for all contacts), and is used only by the refactor-guard test.

HYPE WAND (0–40 points, shown as 8 pips of 5):

GAINS:
- note +1; full trail +2
- Beat Strip +3, or +5 on the beat
- drift T1 / T2 / T3: +3 / +5 / +8
- trick +5
- rocket start +5
- clean gate +2 (no wall contact since the previous gate or the lap start; the finish line counts as the 4th gate)

LOSSES:
- scrape −2
- bump −8
- spin-out → 0
- no passive decay

Passing rivals gives NOTHING, so rivals can never change your time.

WHEN FULL (≥ 40): SPOTLIGHT.
- The wand resets to 0.
- spotlightT = 6.0 s, plus a 1.0 s boost.
- vmax × 1.05 for the duration.
- A bump or spin ends it early.
- Points earned during Spotlight start filling the next wand.

EXPECTED RATE: about 26 points/lap for an Easy-Drive non-drifter (Spotlight about every 1.5 laps), about 50/lap for a drifting 10-year-old.

GATES, LAPS AND THE LIGHT ARC:
- Unchanged: gate order, the [0.25, 0.5, 0.75] fractions, the backwards / wiggle / infield-jump protection and lap counting.
- New: s.lapLight is derived purely from pr.lap: 0 = SOUNDCHECK, 1 = SHOWTIME (only on 3-lap tracks), 2 = ENCORE (the final lap).
- The 'finalLap' event fires on entering the last lap.

GRASS AND WRONG WAY:
- Grass keeps vmax 135 and the 700 px/s² bleed. It drains drift charge and emits a 'grass' event (sound throttled to once per 0.4 s).
- Wrong way is unchanged (banner when wrongT > 0.6). The 3D view adds a hologram arrow.

GLOW CREW RIVALS (5; pure; one-way; deterministic):

REFERENCE RUN:
- On first use per track per session, bakeRef(track) runs the PLAIN autopilot headless with features on for laps+1 laps. Measured: about 10k steps, a few ms.
- It records P and the signed lateral offset every 0.1 s. refMs = its finish time.

REPLAY:
- Rival i keeps its own clock τ_i, advancing at ρ_i·dt.
- P_i = Pref(τ_i) + gridOff_i × max(0, 1 − s.t/8). The grid offset fades over 8 s, so finish times stay exact.
- Position = the centreline at P_i plus clamp(lane_i·HW + 0.5·latRef(τ_i) + dodge_i, ±0.85·HW).
- Heading = direction of motion. Previous pose stored for interpolation.

LANES:
- Gumdrop −0.45, Fizz +0.40, Sprout −0.20, Plum +0.25, Noodle 0.

GRID:
- The player is at today's start (30 px behind the line, centred).
- Rivals are ahead: Gumdrop +55 px / −24 lateral, Fizz +55 / +24, Sprout +110 / −24, Plum +110 / +24, Noodle +165 / 0.
- So you always start P6.

DODGE (rival-side only):
- When |P_i − P_player| < 45 px and |lat diff| < 32 px, the rival eases ±0.5 HW away from you at 125 px/s, and back at 30 px/s once clear.

CLASSES:
- 🌱 TRAINEE (mirror pacing): ρ_i = clamp(m_i·r + 0.15·clamp((P_player − P_i)/400, −1, 1), 0.30, 0.95).
  - m = [0.80, 0.87, 0.93, 0.98, 1.03].
  - r = EWMA (τ 5 s) of the player's dP/dt ÷ refRate, where refRate = (laps·len + 30) / refMs. r is held at 0.75 for the first 2 s and clamped to 0–1.5.
- 🎤 DEBUT: target finish T_i = Silver + (Bronze − Silver) × [0.55, 0.40, 0.25, 0.10, 0].
  - ρ_i = refMs/T_i − 0.06·clamp((P_i − P_player)/500, 0, 1). This is a mercy band: it only slows rivals AHEAD of you, and never chases you.
- 👑 HEADLINER: T_i = Gold + (Silver − Gold) × [0.8, 0.6, 0.4, 0.2, 0].
  - ρ_i = refMs/T_i, with no band. So: win Headliner ⇔ beat Gold.

SOLO PACERS (Solo mode, no rivals):
- Up to 2 holo pacers replaying the same reference: 'Your best' at ρ = refMs/PB (if a PB exists) and 'Next medal' at ρ = refMs/T_next.
- They are lane-offset ±0.35 HW and pass-through, with no dodge.
- At each gate the logic reports the gap: Δ = s.t − (the pacer's time at that gate's P, found by binary search on Pref) / ρ.
- Zero storage: this replaces recorded ghosts.

PLACES AND PASSES:
- Rank by P; rivals that have finished are ranked by finish time.
- A pass or passedBy event fires only after the new place has held for 1.0 s, to stop side-by-side flicker.
- Gap chip = (P_ahead − P_player) / max(60, v) s.
- The place freezes when you cross the line. Rivals that haven't finished are placed by P.
- Rivals keep driving in the coast; when a rival's replay ends it coasts at its last ρ.

FINISH AND VICTORY COAST:
- On the step that sets pr.finished: s.finishT = s.t, the place freezes, and the 'finish' event fires.
- result.ms comes from finishT only.
- Then s.phase = 'coast' for 2.2 s: input is ignored, the plain-autopilot steering drives toward a target of 150 px/s, and progress is frozen.
- The first 0.6 s run at timeScale 0.35 (slow-mo); under api.reduced it is 1.0.
- After that, round.done = true.
- A forceEnd during the coast still returns the finished result.

EVENTS (the only logic→presentation channel):
- race.s.events receives {type, ...} objects.
- Types: go, rocket, boost{src,dur}, driftStart{dir}, driftTier{tier}, driftRelease{tier}, fizzle, pad{i,onBeat}, note{trail,k,full}, jump, trick, land{trick}, scrape{side}, bump, spin, gate{n,clean}, lap{n}, finalLap, lightArc{level}, spotlight, spotlightEnd{early}, wrongWay{on}, grass{on}, pass{rival,place}, passedBy{rival,place}, rivalFinish{i}, pacerGap{kind,dt}, finish{place,ms}.
- The kart.js round wrapper drains them after every step. It maps them to api.sound (so the 2D fallback hears everything) and appends them to round.fx (capped at 64), which the active renderer drains.
- Kept logic sounds: check, coin, bump, fanfare.
consequences:
STAKES ARE REAL BUT NEVER FINAL. Every mistake costs a little time, Hype or Spotlight. Nothing ends the race except the parent's arcade limit, as today. Each consequence has exactly ONE colour, ONE sound, ONE short word and ONE visible change, so a 6-year-old can link cause and effect.

SCRAPE (glancing wall touch, v_n < 70)
- Physics: v × 0.88, plus today's nudge.
- Feedback: 6 Coral (#FF6B6B) and Star Gold sparks from the contact side; 'skid' at 0.6 (at most once per 0.4 s); small word 'Scrape!'.
- Cost: −2 Hype. About 0.05 s.

BUMP (70 ≤ v_n < 180, or any wall contact while airborne)
- Physics: v × 0.5.
- Feedback: the kart squashes to 0.85 on the hit side; the struck candy stack wobbles 0.3 s; the screen shakes 0.06 u for 0.18 s; the kept logic sound 'bump'; word 'Bump!'.
- Cost: −8 Hype, Spotlight ends ('miss' at 0.5, the lights ease back), drift sparks fizzle grey, the boost is cancelled. About 0.16–0.4 s.

SPIN-OUT (v_n ≥ 180, roughly head-on at speed, usually boosting into a hairpin)
- Physics: a 0.8 s cartoon spin of 2 visual turns with a 0.25 u hop. The kart slides at 0.35 × v, decaying at 600 px/s²; controls are ignored.
- MERCY: when the spin ends, the kart faces forward along the track. It can never be left facing a wall.
- Feedback: 3 dizzy ✦ sparkles orbit the pet for 1.2 s and its eyes go >_< swirls; 'bump' + 'oof' + 'boing'; word 'Spin-out!'.
- Cost: Hype → 0, Spotlight ends. About 1.1 s (measured).

LOST CHARGE
- Grass drains spark charge at 2/s and the sparks turn grey: the child SEES the reward evaporating.
- A wall during a drift fizzles it ('miss' at 0.4, a grey puff).
- Dropping below 120 px/s cancels the drift quietly.

GRASS
- Top speed halves to 135, so each second on the verge costs about 0.5 s.
- Dust puffs and 'skid'.

WRONG WAY
- The existing banner after 0.6 s, plus a 3D hologram arrow.
- No lap can count; the progress rules are unchanged.

OFF-BEAT STRIP, MISSED NOTES, NO TRICK
- Never a penalty, just the smaller reward.

RISK / REWARD PAIRS (each risk sits next to its reward)
- A longer drift gives a bigger boost but a wider line toward the wall.
- The outside Beat Strip gives a boost but sets you up on the wrong side for the bend.
- Boosting into a hairpin is the only way to Spin-out.
- Pressing GO too early simply means a normal start.
- The Stage Jump trick has no downside, so the youngest always get one free 'wow'.

WHAT NEVER HAPPENS
- No lives, hearts or DNF.
- No damage, debris, smoke, fire or crying.
- No full-screen white flash.
- Rivals can never hit you, slow you or take your Hype.
- Being passed is never mocked: the rival just waves and the chip turns into a goal ('+0.8 s to P2').
- 4th–6th place is 'Fan Favourite! 💖' with a concrete next target.
- Not finishing in time uses the shell's 'Race stopped' path, worded: 'Time’s up — great driving! Finish all N laps to set a time.'
difficultyCurve:
INSIDE ONE RACE
- Lap 1 SOUNDCHECK teaches: the gates turn mint, the first strips and notes, the first drift.
- Lap 2 SHOWTIME is where most drivers hit their first Spotlight.
- The final ENCORE LAP raises the stakes: key change, cones, bulb chase. Beach (2 laps) goes Soundcheck → Encore.
- Every race starts in P6, so there are guaranteed passes early.

MEDAL LADDER (per track, pinned constants in kart-logic.js PAR)
Formulas, applied to the final autopilots with features on:
- Bronze = ceil to 0.5 s of (plainMs × 1.6)
- Silver = ceil to 0.5 s of (plainMs × 1.12)
- Gold = round to 0.5 s of ((plainMs + styleMs) / 2)
- Holo = ceil to 0.1 s of (styleMs × 1.005)

PROVISIONAL values from the judge's prototype on the real tracks (plain boost-aware 51.36 / 59.84 / 72.13 s; style 49.37 / 52.31 / 65.07 s):
- Island Loop: 🥉 1:22.5 · 🥈 0:58.0 · 🥇 0:50.5 · 🌈 0:49.7
- Volcano Ring: 🥉 1:36.0 · 🥈 1:07.5 · 🥇 0:56.0 · 🌈 0:52.6
- Beach Hairpins: 🥉 1:55.5 · 🥈 1:21.0 · 🥇 1:08.5 · 🌈 1:05.4

The implementer re-measures and pins these. A test keeps every value within ±0.5 s of its formula, so any physics tweak flags medal drift.

What each medal asks:
- Bronze is reachable for a 6-year-old on Easy Drive with bumps.
- Silver needs clean laps but no technique (the plain driver earns it).
- Gold requires boosts (the plain driver must NOT earn it).
- Holo means matching the drifting machine, a 12-year-old mastery goal.
- Volcano and Beach reward drifting most (7–9 s); the gentle Island Loop is mostly about clean lines (about 2 s).

STAGE CLASSES (Race mode; unlocks derived only from world.pb['kart:<track>'].ms — no new storage)
- 🌱 TRAINEE (always open): the Glow Crew mirror the child's own pace, so the pack is always close and winning means using boosts.
- 🎤 DEBUT (opens with a Bronze time on that track): rivals spread between Bronze and Silver pace, with the leader at Silver. Mercy band only.
- 👑 HEADLINER (opens with a Silver time): rivals spread between Silver and Gold, with the leader exactly at Gold and no band. Winning Headliner = a Gold time.
- The menu says plainly: 'Trainee: the Glow Crew race at your pace.'
- The default class is the profile's last choice, else Trainee.

TRACK CHARACTER
- Island Loop (included): gentle, wide, the longest straight with the jump, and a tunnel set-piece. The place to learn.
- Volcano Ring (800 ⭐ in the shop): 13 bends a lap; a drifting playground.
- Beach Hairpins (700 ⭐): long straights for strips and notes, plus 3 hairpins that punish boosting in (spin-outs).
- Each track's strip, note and jump layout comes from the same automatic rule, so buying a track buys a genuinely new rhythm.

SKILL LADDER
Easy Drive + Map cam + Glow Line → manual GO → Chase cam → rocket starts → pink drifts → on-beat strips → gold sparks in hairpins → Headliner win → Holo.

HELPERS THAT NEVER CHANGE PHYSICS
- Easy Drive auto-gas.
- Glow Line (Easy Drive only).
- Map cam.
- Mercy face-forward after a spin.
- Trainee mirror pacing.
powerUpsAndSurprises: SPARK BOOST (drift): Cyan → Pink → Gold sparks, then a 0.5 / 0.9 / 1.3 s boost on release. The ✨ pad glows the same colour.

scoring:
THE SCORE IS THE TRUE RACE CLOCK
- Time runs from GO (sim t = 0) to crossing the line on the last lap. Lower is better, exactly as today.
- Every bonus and penalty is physical: boost speed, slower drift lines, spin-out time, grass. There are no hidden time credits or deductions, so the clock never lies, and the 2D fallback gives identical times for identical inputs.

WHAT CAN AND CANNOT CHANGE YOUR TIME
- Rivals, pacers, class, mode, camera, Easy Drive and kart colour can never change it.
- Passes give no Hype.
- So a PB set in Trainee, Headliner or Solo is the same kind of number.

- Unchanged keys: kart:track_loop, kart:track_volcano, kart:track_beach.
- Recorded through the existing onResult → C.recordResult(u, 'kart', variant, res), only for the profile that launched the game.
- Older 2D PBs were set without boosts, so each child will set a one-time burst of new PBs: a celebratory side effect, the same for every sibling.

- Both are derived on the fly from the PB ms against the pinned PAR table (kart-logic.medalFor / nextMedal / classUnlocked).
- Nothing new is saved.

- VCAP 350 px/s gives Island Loop ≥ 40.6 s, Volcano Ring ≥ 45.5 s and Beach Hairpins ≥ 51.3 s.

autopilot:
Two deterministic drivers live in kart-logic. Both return the same inp shape a child produces ({up, down, left, right, drift}), so they exercise the real rules.

PLAIN DRIVER, race.drivePlain()
- What round.autopilot() uses by default.
- Today's steering: look 95 px ahead, steer if |diff| > 0.04.
- Today's bend braking targets: 175 for a bend > 1.4 rad over 170 px, 215 for > 0.8, else VMAX.
- One change, BOOST-AWARE: when boostT > 0 and the bend ≤ 0.8 rad, the target becomes VBOOST, so it doesn't brake a boost away.
- It never drifts, never seeks strips or notes, and never tricks.
- Role: the fairness reference. It is the source of bakeRef (the rival replays), Bronze / Silver and the plainMs used in the PAR formulas, and it drives the existing wall-free tests.
- Prototype on today's tracks: 51.36 / 59.84 / 72.13 s with 0 wall contacts. The unchanged non-boost-aware version also stays wall-free.

STYLE DRIVER, race.driveStyle()
- Used when cfg.demo or cfg.autoStyle is set.
- Steering is measured against the travel angle (h − dir·slide).
- Starts a drift when the bend over the next 200 px > enter, v ≥ 160, no boost is active and |diff| < 0.5.
- While drifting, steers into or against the drift to follow the look point.
- Releases at T3, or at relCharge once the bend over the next 120 px is < 0.25.
- Per-track STYLE table (prototype values with 0 walls):
  - Loop {enter 0.6, rel 1.8} → 49.37 s
  - Volcano {enter 0.45, rel 0.55} → 52.31 s
  - Beach {enter 0.35, rel 1.8} → 65.07 s
- Adds:
  - pad-seeking: the lateral target becomes the pad's offset within 300 px of it, unless a bend > 0.8 rad lies within the next 250 px
  - a trick on every jump
  - a rocket start, via the countdown hook, at countT 0.1
- Role: the source of Gold and Holo par, the shop preview and the 3D QA.

SHOP PREVIEW
- 7 s, style driver, Race mode in Debut class, so a lively pack is visible.
- 3D when available (opts.demo), else today's 2D demo.

TEST DUTIES
- Both drivers must finish every track with zero wall contacts and a valid result.
- The style driver must beat Holo par, Gold par must sit between the two drivers, and the plain driver must earn Silver but not Gold.
- The rivals' Headliner leader must cross the line within 0.05 s of Gold.
- A deterministic 'sloppy child' model, used only in tests, checks that Trainee keeps the pack close: the plain driver with a seeded xorshift steering wobble (±0.12 rad look-point jitter), 0.25 s input delay and throttle lifts on 15% of 1 s windows.

TIME FLOOR: for every track, track.len × laps / VCAP ≥ 40 s. Forcing boost on every step (a test hook) never exceeds v = 350, and the finish is still ≥ minMs 30000.

RIVALS ARE ONE-WAY: the player's pose log, ms and wand values are identical with rivals off, Trainee, Debut, Headliner and Solo pacers. No rival event changes the wand.

GLOW NOTES: every note centre is within HW. Each note is collected at most once per lap and respawns on the lap event. A full trail awards the +2 bonus exactly once.

STAGE JUMP: launch only when v ≥ 160 and moving forwards; airDur = 0.35 + 0.0012·v; a trick only in the first 70% of airtime; a jump never skips a gate (the gate log stays in order); any wall contact while airborne grades as a bump.

GRADED WALLS: a scripted head-on at 300 px/s produces a spin-out lasting exactly 0.8 s, after which the heading equals the forward track tangent (±0.01 rad); a glancing 20° contact at 150 is a scrape; s.wall counts every grade with the 0.4 s debounce.
